$comment: `groups`: source folders under skills/ (README tables). `installerGroups`: the selectable groups in `npx skills add`, written to .claude-plugin/marketplace.json by `npm run generate`. Each skill goes in the FIRST installer group whose `include` pattern matches its path under skills/ (`folder/**`, `**`, or an exact path); the CLI sorts groups by `plugin` name. `upstreams`: run `npm run sync` to pull them; each is copied into `dest` (wiped first) and `skills` lists which skill folders to take. Optional `overlay` is re-applied after every sync: `files` is a folder mirroring `dest` whose files are copied over the synced copy, `frontmatter` maps a skill (path under `dest`, or its folder name when `dest` is the skill) to SKILL.md frontmatter keys to set.
